shortDescription: Investors may shift toward domestic demand-reliant Japanese stocks that could benefit from a stronger currency after the yen rose beyond the exchange-rate assumptions listed companies used for earnings forecasts, according to Bloomberg.

title: Yen Surge Cuts Into Japan Corporate Buffers, Raises Earnings Risk
